curation.basis: kept only where the backend resolved the expected company and agreed with the obvious reading

headlines.text: Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC reported a 32% rise in profit after tax for the quarter, supported by lower impairment charges and stronger net interest margins.
Dialog Axiata PLC announces acquisition of Airtel Lanka operations, expanding its subscriber base significantly across the island.
Hatton National Bank PLC declared a final dividend of LKR 10.00 per share following a strong full-year performance.
Lanka IOC PLC benefits from favourable refining margins as global crude prices ease.
LOLC Holdings PLC announces the divestment of its stake in a regional microfinance subsidiary at a substantial gain.
Ceylon Cold Stores PLC posts strong beverage growth driven by the summer season and new product launches.
Keells Food Products PLC expands processing capacity with a new facility investment.
Dilmah Ceylon Tea Company PLC grows export revenue on the back of premium brand demand.
Cargills (Ceylon) PLC (CARG) opens 50 new retail outlets, accelerating its expansion into rural markets.
Sampath Bank PLC reports record fee income and improved asset quality for the financial year.
Aitken Spence PLC sees hotel occupancy improve as tourist arrivals climb year on year.
Ceylon Tobacco Company PLC lifts full-year earnings on firm pricing and stable volumes.
Melstacorp PLC posts a decline in earnings as beverage volumes weaken.
Teejay Lanka PLC reports a steep fall in export orders and warns of weaker margins ahead.
Malwatte Valley Plantations PLC posts a loss as crop yields deteriorate and costs rise.
HVA Foods PLC reports widening losses amid weak demand and margin pressure.
Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC lifts profit on stronger industrial demand and pricing.
Nations Trust Bank PLC grows profit sharply on lower provisioning and higher fee income.
Hemas Holdings PLC posts higher earnings driven by its consumer and healthcare segments.
Sunshine Holdings PLC delivers strong growth across its healthcare and consumer businesses.
